questions.question: Which endpoint names and units are actually labelled?
questions.required_evidence: Exact sheet/cell labels and nearby documentary hierarchy. Do not infer a proof-strain level from an unrelated material-history field.

questions.question: Which identifiers link endpoints to the same test or specimen?
questions.required_evidence: Literal identifier labels and row/column association, with merged-range provenance distinguished from author-imposed fill. Repeated display identifiers do not alone establish specimen, heat or batch independence.

questions.question: How are uncertainty quantities defined?
questions.required_evidence: Documentary definitions distinguishing standard uncertainty, expanded uncertainty, relative/absolute units, coverage factor and any stated probability. A label or stored number alone does not validate coverage.

questions.question: What do stored formulas and cached values establish?
questions.required_evidence: Separate unexecuted formula text, raw caches and literal labels. Do not use caches as recomputed or verified results; preserve missing or inconsistent cached values.

questions.question: Are shared error sources or covariance specified?
questions.required_evidence: Literal uncertainty component/source labels, documentary common-input references and any explicit covariance/correlation definitions. Repeated calibration/equipment labels are provenance clues, not measured dependence or exchangeability.

questions.question: What remains necessary before any validation use?
questions.required_evidence: List concrete documentary gaps and unobserved components. This exposed route may support metrology-reference engineering only, never a fresh blind predictive test or new scientific protocol.
